model: Joint home/away score conditional-outcome forest v1
status: Research game projections; not a validated betting-return model

aggregate.calibrationScope: Home-win probabilities; ties are not wins. Reconstructed final-corrected public games, not archived sportsbook wagers.

limitations: No sportsbook spreads, totals or moneylines enter the predictors.
Joint observed home/away score pairs preserve empirical margin/total dependence.
Current roster, injury and weather impacts are not independently calibrated in this game model.
Fair two-way moneylines condition on no tie; settlement rules require review.
70% estimated win probability does not establish a realized 70% win rate or profitability.
No historical odds ROI or CLV is claimed.
